topics.description: The fatal shooting of a Mexican immigrant by ICE agents in Houston has sparked outrage and calls for an independent investigation.
topics.reason: The shooting has raised concerns about police brutality and racial profiling.

topics.description: There have been several recent investigations into birth tourism schemes in Texas, including one involving Mission Regional Medical Center.
topics.reason: The schemes involve hospitals and clinics allegedly advertising for pregnant women to give birth in the US, often for financial gain.
